thought
Whoa, lots of rich details! Let's unpack those!
1. Airspace closures coming into force / amended while drones are in the air.
2. Patchy radio coverage, reports arriving late, out of order, more than once, or not at all.
3. Batteries draining faster in cold and wind.
4. Platform service crashing or restarting while drones are flying.

Let's follow up on what happens when a closure comes into force or is amended while your drones are already in the air, or when batteries drain faster. Let's ask one open question at a time.When an airspace closure suddenly comes into force or gets widened while your drones are already flying, what do you have to do?
